description: This file implements HTTP Content-Type Autonegotiation, including parsing Accept headers and content negotiation logic, following RFC 2616.

methods.name: Len
methods.description: Returns the length of the acceptSlice.

methods.name: Less
methods.description: Defines sorting order for acceptSlice based on Q value and wildcard precedence.

methods.name: ParseAccept
methods.description: Parses an Accept header string into a sorted list of Accept clauses.

methods.name: Negotiate
methods.description: Selects the most appropriate content type based on the Accept header and available alternatives.
